<head>

  <style>

    }

    body {
      width: 100%;

    }

    }

    }

    .caption h1 {

    }

    .caption p {
      margin: 0;

      font-size: 12px;
      letter-spacing: 0.08em;
      text-transform: uppercase;

</head>
<body>
  <div class="caption">
    <h1>Brittle Star</h1>
    <p>Drag to orbit · Scroll to zoom</p>
  </div>

  <script type="module">
    import * as THREE from
      "https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/three.js/0.160.0/three.module.min.js";

    const scene = new THREE.Scene();
    scene.background = new THREE.Color(0x0b2625);
    scene.fog = new THREE.Fog(0x0b2625, 10, 22);

    const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(
      38,
      innerWidth / innerHeight,
      0.1,
      50
    );

    const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({
      antialias: true,
      powerPreference: "high-performance"
    });

    renderer.setPixelRatio(Math.min(devicePixelRatio, 2));
    renderer.setSize(innerWidth, innerHeight);
    renderer.outputColorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
    renderer.toneMapping = THREE.ACESFilmicToneMapping;
    renderer.toneMappingExposure = 1.12;
    renderer.shadowMap.enabled = true;
    renderer.shadowMap.type = THREE.PCFSoftShadowMap;
    document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

    // Deterministic random helper for the procedural sponge texture.
    function mulberry32(seed) {
      return function () {
        let t = (seed += 0x6d2b79f5);
        t = Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 15), t | 1);
        t ^= t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), t | 61);
        return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
      };
    }

    function createSpongeTextures() {
      const size = 512;
      const random = mulberry32(8147);

      const colorCanvas = document.createElement("canvas");
      const bumpCanvas = document.createElement("canvas");
      colorCanvas.width = colorCanvas.height = size;
      bumpCanvas.width = bumpCanvas.height = size;

      const colorContext = colorCanvas.getContext("2d");
      const bumpContext = bumpCanvas.getContext("2d");
      const colorImage = colorContext.createImageData(size, size);
      const bumpImage = bumpContext.createImageData(size, size);

      for (let i = 0; i < colorImage.data.length; i += 4) {
        const noise = (random() - 0.5) * 34;
        const broad = Math.sin((i / 4) * 0.071) * 5;
        const red = 132 + noise + broad;
        const green = 83 + noise * 0.72 + broad;
        const blue = 48 + noise * 0.52 + broad * 0.65;

        colorImage.data[i] = red;
        colorImage.data[i + 1] = green;
        colorImage.data[i + 2] = blue;
        colorImage.data[i + 3] = 255;

        const height = 128 + noise * 2.2 + broad * 2;
        bumpImage.data[i] = height;
        bumpImage.data[i + 1] = height;
        bumpImage.data[i + 2] = height;
        bumpImage.data[i + 3] = 255;
      }

      colorContext.putImageData(colorImage, 0, 0);
      bumpContext.putImageData(bumpImage, 0, 0);

      // Draw irregular pores and small surface highlights.
      for (let i = 0; i < 1150; i++) {
        const x = random() * size;
        const y = random() * size;
        const radius = 0.5 + random() * 4.2;
        const pore = random() > 0.28;

        colorContext.beginPath();
        colorContext.arc(x, y, radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        colorContext.fillStyle = pore
          ? `rgba(48, 25, 15, ${0.14 + random() * 0.35})`
          : `rgba(226, 174, 112, ${0.08 + random() * 0.18})`;
        colorContext.fill();

        bumpContext.beginPath();
        bumpContext.arc(x, y, radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        bumpContext.fillStyle = pore
          ? `rgba(35, 35, 35, ${0.25 + random() * 0.45})`
          : `rgba(220, 220, 220, ${0.15 + random() * 0.3})`;
        bumpContext.fill();
      }

      const colorTexture = new THREE.CanvasTexture(colorCanvas);
      colorTexture.colorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
      colorTexture.wrapS = colorTexture.wrapT = THREE.RepeatWrapping;
      colorTexture.repeat.set(2.8, 1.8);
      colorTexture.anisotropy = renderer.capabilities.getMaxAnisotropy();

      const bumpTexture = new THREE.CanvasTexture(bumpCanvas);
      bumpTexture.wrapS = bumpTexture.wrapT = THREE.RepeatWrapping;
      bumpTexture.repeat.copy(colorTexture.repeat);
      bumpTexture.anisotropy = renderer.capabilities.getMaxAnisotropy();

      return { colorTexture, bumpTexture };
    }

    const { colorTexture, bumpTexture } = createSpongeTextures();

    const spongeMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
      color: 0xffffff,

    // A lathed, hollow barrel shape with a softly irregular silhouette.
    const spongeProfile = [

    const spongeGeometry = new THREE.LatheGeometry(spongeProfile, 96);
    const spongePositions = spongeGeometry.attributes.position;

    // Add gentle organic deformation to the sponge surface.
    for (let i = 0; i < spongePositions.count; i++) {
      const x = spongePositions.getX(i);
      const y = spongePositions.getY(i);
      const z = spongePositions.getZ(i);
      const radius = Math.hypot(x, z);

      if (radius > 0.08) {
        const angle = Math.atan2(z, x);
        const deformation =
          Math.sin(angle * 7.0 + y * 3.1) * 0.032 +
          Math.sin(angle * 13.0 - y * 4.2) * 0.015 +
          Math.sin(angle * 3.0 - y * 2.0) * 0.018;

        const scale = 1 + deformation;
        spongePositions.setX(i, x * scale);
        spongePositions.setZ(i, z * scale);
      }
    }

    spongeGeometry.computeVertexNormals();

    function addJointedArm(definition, pointIndex) {
      const arm = new THREE.Group();
      organism.add(arm);

      const angle = definition.angle;
      const radial = new THREE.Vector3(
        Math.cos(angle),
        0,
        Math.sin(angle)
      );
      const tangent = new THREE.Vector3(
        -Math.sin(angle),
        0,
        Math.cos(angle)
      );

      const controlPoints = [
        { radius: 0.20, y: 3.20 },
        { radius: 0.58, y: 3.43 },
        { radius: 0.96, y: 3.40 },
        { radius: 1.28, y: 3.18 },
        { radius: 1.50, y: 2.78 },
        { radius: 1.59, y: 2.30 },
        { radius: 1.55, y: 1.88 },
        { radius: 1.38, y: 1.61 },
        { radius: 1.08, y: 1.62 },
        { radius: 0.72, y: 1.76 },
        { radius: 0.36, y: 1.88 }
      ];

      const points = controlPoints.map((control, index) => {
        const t = index / (controlPoints.length - 1);
        const radius = control.radius * definition.scale;
        const height =
          control.y +
          definition.lift +
          Math.sin(index * 1.73 + definition.phase) * 0.035;

        return new THREE.Vector3(
          radial.x * radius + tangent.x * definition.swerve * t,
          height,
          radial.z * radius + tangent.z * definition.swerve * t
        );
      });

      const curve = new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3(
        points,
        false,
        "catmullrom",
        0.5
      );
      const sampled = curve.getPoints(12);

      const rootRadius = 0.095;
      const tipRadius = 0.022;

      for (let i = 0; i < sampled.length - 1; i++) {
        const t0 = i / (sampled.length - 1);
        const t1 = (i + 1) / (sampled.length - 1);
        const start = sampled[i];
        const end = sampled[i + 1];
        const direction = new THREE.Vector3().subVectors(end, start);
        const length = direction.length();

        const radiusStart = THREE.MathUtils.lerp(
          rootRadius,
          tipRadius,
          Math.pow(t0, 0.82)
        );
        const radiusEnd = THREE.MathUtils.lerp(
          rootRadius,
          tipRadius,
          Math.pow(t1, 0.82)
        );

        const segment = new THREE.Mesh(
          new THREE.CylinderGeometry(
            radiusEnd,
            radiusStart,
            length,
            10,
            1,
            false
          ),
          brittleMaterial
        );

        segment.position.copy(start).add(end).multiplyScalar(0.5);
        segment.quaternion.setFromUnitVectors(
          new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0),
          direction.normalize()
        );
        segment.castShadow = true;
        segment.receiveShadow = true;
        arm.add(segment);

        const jointRadius = Math.max(
          radiusEnd * 1.12,
          0.026
        );

        const joint = new THREE.Mesh(
          new THREE.SphereGeometry(jointRadius, 10, 8),
          jointMaterial
        );
        joint.position.copy(end);
        joint.scale.y = 0.88;
        joint.castShadow = true;
        joint.receiveShadow = true;
        arm.add(joint);
      }
    }
